text: Launch. The projectile leaves at eight metres per second and forty-five degrees. Watch the horizontal component vx stay constant while the vertical component vy starts large. This cue timing sets up the flight in SI units.
Apex. At the top of the arc the vertical velocity vy is zero while vx carries the projectile forward. The apex marker appears exactly on this cue, at the apex frame.

Landing. Gravity has pulled vy negative, mirror to launch, while vx is unchanged and the range reads about six point five metres. The cue timing closes as the dot touches down; predict the landing spot before replaying, then compare.
